nodes.label: Context Quarantine Rule
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator passes only {"messages": [...]} into each subgraph — never its own message history. Each step gets a unique thread_id so MessagesState checkpoints are isolated between steps. This prevents context bleed and prompt injection from previous step results.

nodes.label: Human Approval Gate Rule
nodes.rationale: Consequential actions require explicit user approval. NodeInterrupt pauses; approval state is persisted; never infer approval from silence; LLM cannot approve its own high-risk action. Ensures human is the authority for irreversible external actions.

nodes.label: Permission Levels Policy
nodes.rationale: LOW=read/search, MEDIUM=logged-in interaction/draft, HIGH=external side effects. Enforcement is in application code, not model reasoning, to prevent the LLM from overriding safety decisions.

nodes.label: LangGraph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: create_react_agent for every specialized agent, PostgresSaver as only checkpointing backend, NodeInterrupt for HITL, BaseCallbackHandler for tracing. Community tools must be wrapped via to_langchain_tool() and ToolExecutionEngine.

nodes.label: No Redis — PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED is used for task queuing instead of Redis, reducing infrastructure dependencies. Scheduler also uses PostgreSQL for the same reason (autonomy roadmap Appendix B, decision 3).
